startAt.description: Start date. Must be in MM/YYYY format (e.g., '02/2025').

endAt.description: End date. Must be in MM/YYYY format (e.g., '12/2025') or null if currently in progress.

description.description: A brief summary of the project. Must end with a period (.).

isHighlighted.description: Determines whether the project is featured/highlighted with a star.

media.description: Project media assets (images and videos). Must follow the folder path structure.

image.description: Image file path. Must start with '/projects/images/' and end with a valid extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp).

video.description: Video file path or null. Must start with '/projects/videos/' and end with a valid extension (.mp4, .webm, .mov).

urls.description: External project links (GitHub, Live Preview, Articles).

topics.description: List of project topics/accomplishments. Intermediate items must end with a semicolon (;) and the very last item must end with a period (.).

items.description: Each item must end with either a semicolon (;) or a period (.).

tags.description: Comma-separated project tags. Must follow the 'Tag, Tag, Tag' spacing pattern.
